primary_estimand: Mean over 486 aligned tabular features of pair-specific quantile-bin JS(hybrid) minus JS(covariance-matched); negative favors the graph.
primary_unit: One random-split and GraphSAGE seed, conditional on the observed transactions and fixed forward-time evaluation period.
secondary: Baseline-to-hybrid JS, within-row top-10 and Spearman differences, scale and Wasserstein diagnostics. Confidence intervals for individual measures are pointwise; secondary metrics are exploratory.
catboost_inner: 85 percent chronological cutoff inside outer training data; refit representation and trees on all outer training data using selected tree count.
wide_control: 703 dimensions fixed from historical experiment; check attained scale empirically. The Wasserstein contrasts at seed 42 are descriptive.
pilot: 6000 actual transactions sampled with random_state=42 before temporal ordering; reduced fits only. Excluded from full-data inference.

runner_changes.change: Checkpoint each arm atomically and score before SHAP; original full run stopped before saving a split.
